title: Monarch CLI structured error (v1)
description: Normative contract for the structured error object emitted on stderr for pre-execution validation, authorization, and read failures (MonarchCLIError.to_dict()). It is also the stderr contract for blocked mutations and invalid input. `code` is an open set: new error codes may be added additively, so it is intentionally not a closed enum. `details` is an open object whose keys vary by error code. Additive-only: new optional properties may be added; removing or renaming a property, narrowing nullability, tightening a type, or adding a required property requires a new schema version.

error.description: Always true; distinguishes a structured error object from normalized data.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error classification. Open set; current values include AUTH_REQUIRED, AUTH_EXPIRED, AUTH_FAILED, MUTATION_BLOCKED, MUTATION_AMBIGUOUS, PROMPT_BLOCKED, POLICY_VIOLATION, NOT_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, API_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED, NETWORK_ERROR, TIMEOUT, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, and UNKNOWN. New codes may be added without a version change.

message.description: Human-readable, sanitized error message. Never contains credentials or raw request bodies.

details.description: Structured, error-code-specific context. Keys vary by code; object-valued in all cases.
